'''''Impending Doom''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Starfleet]].

==History==
The ''Impending Doom'' was the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Nile Owen]] and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Sahreel]] of the [[Rayter sector/Legends|Rayter sector]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Owen used the ship during [[Operation 45RA]] to gain the favor of the [[Shashay]] and to deal with the traitor [[Braig Farool]].
